name: GIS disconnector compartment reference
summary: Identifies the documented isolation function within the selected gas-insulated arrangement.
description: Identifies the documented isolation function within the selected gas-insulated arrangement. High-voltage primary equipment carries, interrupts, measures or conditions the main power circuit. Its function, insulation arrangement and equipment boundaries need to be distinguished from the secondary signals used to control it.

In a switchyard equipment diagram, the primary reference identifies the electrical role of an installed component while the linked equipment schedule and manufacturer drawing supply its exact construction and dimensions. For this reference, the drawing identifies “GIS primary path” at the input and “GIS disconnector function” at the output. Position indication is distinct from visible outdoor isolation.
